# Codync

> Codync is the open-source (Apache 2.0) Grok Bot alternative, and a Muse and Dots alternative too. Free. It turns the AI agents on your own computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode and about 40 more over the Agent Client Protocol) into persistent named bots, for code and everyday tasks, that you message from an iPhone, a Mac, a Windows PC, a Linux desktop or a terminal.

Key facts:

- Price: $0, every feature included. No subscription, no paid tier, no in-app purchases. You pay only your agent's provider, through the plan or API key you already have (for example Claude Code with a Claude plan, Codex with a ChatGPT plan).
- Where it runs: `codync-host`, one Rust binary, on macOS, Windows (x64, bundled in the desktop app) or Linux (desktop or headless server, static binary for x86_64 and arm64). Bots, chats and memory stay on that computer.
- Clients: native SwiftUI iPhone app (iOS 18+), one Electron desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, and a terminal UI (`codync-host tui`) that works over SSH.
- Features: persistent bots with their own agent, project folder and instructions; group chats where bots answer in turn; reply threads; bots asking each other for help; approval cards (allow once, always allow, deny) on the phone; per-bot memory; routines on a schedule or webhook; connectors from the MCP registry, apps through Composio, and skills; remote screen over WebRTC; voice calls; "needs you" and "done" push notifications.
- Remote access: a free Cloudflare relay, end-to-end encrypted between phone and computer, or a direct connection on the same network or Tailscale. No account required; pairing is a QR code.
- Not affiliated with Grok Bot, Muse, Dots, Anthropic, OpenAI or any agent vendor.

## Get it

- [Download for Mac (DMG)](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync/releases/latest/download/codync-macos.dmg): Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized
- [Download for Windows (installer)](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync/releases/latest/download/codync-windows-x64.exe): x64; not code-signed yet, so Windows asks to confirm the first run. No remote screen on Windows yet.
- [iPhone app on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/codync/id6760984418)
- [All releases (Linux AppImage, .deb, .tar.gz)](https://github.com/leepokai/Codync/releases/latest)
- One-line install on macOS or Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leepokai/Codync/main/packaging/install.sh | sh`
- Homebrew: `brew install --cask leepokai/codync/codync` (Mac app) or `brew install leepokai/codync/codync-host` (host only)
